newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs must clear 136.40 for upside break.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs must clear 136.40 for upside break.

text.p: September BTPs must close above the key 136.40 level if they are to make a fresh challenge on the 137.10 contract high, technical analysts said on Friday.
If they fail to make the grade, they will drift back to support at 135.84 ahead of 135.33, they added.
"I doubt we'll break out of the 135.84 to high 136s range today," said Marc Ostwald, technical analyst at London Bond Broking.
"It really needs to hold the key 136.40 level. If it can do that, there's the possibility of another run up to 137.10."
Charts show the market hit a high of 136.40 on July 7 and 8.
By 0730 GMT September BTPs were down 12 basis points at 136.32 after briefly touching 136.43 earlier in the session.
Ostwald put initial support at 135.84, the low from Thursday and the high from July 4. Below there, a large area of congestion at 135.33,38 will kick in, he said.
"If that goes, we'll start breaking down quite heavily," said Ostwald, adding 134.55 was the next major support, the high on July 1.

Analysts at an Italian bank in London said the September contract was eyeing 137.10 where it would face strong psychological resistance."Only a sustained bullish breakout of this level will bring more upside potential," they said in a note.
By 0740 GMT, September Eurolira were unchanged at 93.34.
